opportunities.name: Ryanair flight search and fare selection
opportunities.description: Search Ryanair flights from a given origin to a destination for given outbound/return dates, then select the outbound and return flights (optionally applying a promo code).
steps: Open the 'From' field and choose the origin airport (by country list or by typing)
Open the 'To' field and choose the destination country and airport
Pick the outbound date in the calendar (go to the right month)
Pick the return date
Click Done / Search
Click Select on the outbound flight
Click Select on the return flight
Optionally pick a fare, enter the promo code and click Apply promo code / Search

instances.values: First tried Athens (Greece), then Dublin -> Malta; dates 22 and 5; selected outbound and return flights
Tel Aviv / Dublin -> Paris Beauvais, then Venice Treviso; May 9 - May 16; selected flights and fare; promo code 1000001

opportunities.name: Booking.com attraction search and date check
opportunities.description: Search Booking.com Attractions for a given attraction or city, pick a date, and open the result to check availability and tickets.
steps: Click 'Attractions'
Type the attraction or city in 'Where are you going?' (or browse by region) and pick the suggestion
Click 'Select your dates' and tick the date
Click Search
Optionally sort or filter (e.g. Most popular)
Open the attraction result / See availability
Choose the date and ticket quantity, then click Next

instances.values: Asia -> Kyoto, 25 May 2023, sorted by Most popular

opportunities.name: Resy restaurant availability notification
opportunities.description: Search Resy for a restaurant or cuisine (in a given city), open a restaurant, set the date and party size, and sign up for a 'Notify' alert for a meal period.
steps: Change the location city if needed
Type the cuisine or restaurant name in the search box
Open the restaurant result
Set the date and number of guests
Click 'Notify for <meal>'
Optionally set a preferred time window and click Confirm

instances.values: thai -> Senyai Thai Kitchen, Notify for Dinner, end time 7:00 PM
